_why: Skill-candidates row 'audit-prompt preflight false-HALTs on a gated document that QUOTES a slot token', fixed as a class: all three assemblers filled slots one `str.replace` at a time and scanned the FILLED text for residue, so a document quoting a slot token was rewritten and/or halted. `fill_slots` fills in one pass and returns the template residue; these rows prove each site's test bites.

mutations.name: slots-are-filled-one-at-a-time-again
mutations._mechanism: A quoted token inside an already-inserted document is rewritten by a later slot.
mutations.find: return rx.sub(lambda m: slots[m.group(0)], text), rx.sub("", text)

mutations.name: the-residue-is-the-filled-text
mutations._mechanism: Every residual scan reads inserted documents again, and a quoted token halts the audit assembly.
mutations.find: return rx.sub(lambda m: slots[m.group(0)], text), rx.sub("", text)
mutations.replace:
filled = rx.sub(lambda m: slots[m.group(0)], text)
    return filled, filled

mutations.name: preflight-ignores-the-template-residue
mutations._mechanism: assemble passes the residue, preflight scans the whole prompt anyway.
mutations.find: slot_text = text if slot_text is None else slot_text

mutations.name: tdd-scans-the-filled-prompt
mutations._mechanism: A task naming `<INLINE_X>` halts residual_slots on its own prose.

mutations.name: archreview-scans-the-filled-prompt
mutations._mechanism: A design naming a slot reads as a live placeholder and staging is refused UNSUBSTITUTED.

mutations.name: a-real-unfilled-slot-is-not-found
mutations._mechanism: The check moved to the template; dropping it would ship a live placeholder.
mutations.find: if residual := [ln for ln in slot_text.splitlines() if "<INLINE_" in ln]:
